description: This file defines interfaces and classes for managing E1AP protocol procedures in a 3GPP telecommunications context, including connection management, message handling, statistics, and notifications for the CU-UP component.

classes.name: e1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing E1AP connection procedures such as setup and release.

classes.name: e1ap_control_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling E1AP control messages related to bearer contexts and data notifications.

classes.name: e1ap_statistics_handler
classes.description: Interface for querying statistics from the E1AP interface, such as number of registered UEs.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_message_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP manager of received messages like bearer context setup, modification, release, and E1 reset.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_connection_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP manager of connection loss events.

classes.name: e1ap_interface
classes.description: Combined interface for E1AP handling, inheriting multiple protocol handling interfaces.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_notifier
classes.description: Combined notifier class for CU-UP manager, inheriting message and connection notifiers.
